ghiChu: Dang MOI, khac han 4 dang da biet (day_du/rut_gon/xac_nhan_trong + bien the). Header dung THU TU day_du (PARAM,TYPE,STR,ID) nhung KHONG co INSTIDENTITY, KHONG co the _InstID, va thay vi echo du lieu CUA CHINH dataTag nay (OBJ_WLANSETTING_ID/OBJ_CHANNEL_ID) thi lai echo OBJ_WLANMLO_ID (trang thai MLO — mot doi tuong KHONG lien quan truc tiep) VOI CHI 2/3 truong (_InstID, MloEnable — thieu MLOSSID so voi dinh nghia object day du). Co the la loi/hanh vi phu cua firmware that (kiem tra trang thai MLO sau khi doi radio setting). Lan thu dau bi loi -1452 (token cu) - da tai lai / roi thu lai thanh cong.
